summary: SEACOR Marine Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a letter agreement that modifies an existing credit facility: releases $13.7M from a restricted escrow account and cancels $24.6M in undrawn Tranche B commitments previously designated for two platform supply vessels under construction. The company also disclosed the sale of five vessels held for sale, generating $46.5M in gross proceeds, reducing its fleet to 38 vessels. These are ordinary financing and asset-sale updates, not a special situation like an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No tender, activist, or strategic review is involved.
